governed.reasoning: Bot-owned pull requests only, pinned to the caller's explicit expected_head_sha. A queue-shaped gh pr merge (optionally --auto) maps to enqueue, never to a direct merge. Plexus checks ownership, open state and the head before enqueuePullRequest; jumping remains operator-only.

The shim-only gh pr dequeue removes only the bot's own pull request from the merge queue. Plexus checks ownership and open state before dequeuePullRequest. No body is admitted; upstream --disable-auto retains its existing operator classification.
